[spoiler=Panesan City States]

The Context of the Developments in the 1500s in the Panesan City States

Following the collapse of the Imperium, its metropole located in Panesa fell into ruin as hundreds of various petty kingdoms and warlord states were forged in the aftermath. The collapse of the government would mean that the legions under their command would become unemployed, often roaming the countryside terrorizing the peasantry. During this time the area would experience a remarkable downfall from being the heartland of a significant and domineering empire of Elseyr to yet another backwater during 500s Elseyr. Eventually, the area would begin to recover from the collapse of the imperium although very slowly. By the early 1000s the Panesan states of the north had been organized into almost 100 different city-states each controlling their piece of northern Panesa. To the south lay the Kingdom of South Panesa which incorporates the modern day Semi-Autonomous Free Republic of Panesa as well as Elseyrstaat also known as the former Bobian Elseyr Exclave. 

Over time the sprawling mass of city states would begin to consolidate until the early 1200s when several major city states were formed in the aftermath. These included the cities of Monteverdi located in the far north, situated next to an important harbor for pan-Elseyr trade. Rivabella is located further upstream and in control of the valuable farmlands that lay on either side of the Arno. Belacqua further to the south, on the border with the Kingdom of South Panesa also held a significant role in international trade by helping to bring the riches and luxury goods of the east to Elseyr. Another important city was Fioralba which processed wool imported from the Hochdeutsche Kingdoms to the north into various different textiles which would then be sent down the Arno to Rivabella or Monteverdi to be sold. 

During the 1400s these city states would experience a remarkable surge in economic but also social productivity in terms of art and creativity. The Panesan city states an extremely strategic location in western Elseyr, near the great lakes would allow them to bring in luxury goods from Armalo and Vespuria which would then be shipped north to the Hochdeutsche and other large Kingdoms. Royals, nobles and wealthy merchants would all pay enormous sums to get their hands on luxury goods including pepper, various spices, silk and art. This would begin to be known as the Rivabella route, named after the city that served as the axis between east and west. This Panesan city bustled in activity with its central market overlooked by a massive cathedral hosting merchants from as far as the northern Hochdeutsche states to Vespuria. One of the most valuable goods purchased from Vespuria in particularly would be cocoa which would then be processed in Elseyr into chocolate and other goods which the wealth particularly desired. 

Another reason for the increase in prosperity of northern Panesa was the end of the feudal system. Due to the lessened influence of the Church in the more pluralistic city-states of Rivabella and Monteverdi there would be more individual freedom. No man was bound to a lord in the north and was free to do as he wished as long as he complied with the law of the various city states he lived in. Social mobility drove economic growth as various people of meager beginnings were now allowed to pursue wealth through commercial means. Antonio de Luminaria among these would begin as the son of sheepherders and later ascend to one of the wealthiest men in Monteverdi through his shipping and banking businesses. Finally, the Panesan northern states also were wealthy in agricultural produce. The fertile Arno river ran through their lands allowing them to produce an agricultural surplus fairly reliably. This surplus not only helped feed their quite significant urban populations but also provided an export to send overseas. 

Additionally, the evolution of finance in Panesa would make ease of business remarkably easier than in the feudal states that surrounded it. Transferring money, down payments, bank holdings, loans, insurance and access to capital were all things that Panesan bankers and businessmen pioneered. These allowed Panesan businessmen to progress at a rate unseen by the others in Elseyr allowing their financial and shipping networks to expand at an unprecedented rate. To the south, however, things werent so pretty. The feudal Kingdom of South Panesa lagged behind its northern neighbors, bound in the chains of feudalism and economic stagnation, the lasting scars of the collapse of the imperium. 

Social Revival

As enormous sums of money began to be generated by the north Panesan city states an unprecedented revival of imperium culture would begin. Wealthy Panesans in cities such as Monteverdi and Rivabella would begin patronage of the arts, supporting various artisans in their artworks. A sense of civic pride would drive these projects with beautiful statues adorning not just the countryside villas of the wealthy but also public squares. Masterful artworks would be produced during this time period with a return to the humanist values of the imperium and the republic, a far cry from the relatively flat medieval art being produced at the time. Many of these Panesan artworks from that time period are now held in the museums of the Neue Republik. 

Antonio of Monteverdi would be a significant patron of the arts at this time commissioning great works still remembered to this day including the Day on the Arno depicting a leisure boat cruising through the Arno River as well as various statues of the imperiums gods. Various important literatures of the former imperium would also be revived during this period including philosophical works which would help refocus from a communal style of medieval living to the individualistic ideas of the modern age of Elseyr. 

Architecture would also change significantly during this period. The northern city states would reject the norm of gothic architecture, instead they helped lead the Imperial Revival style which utilized domes, circular architecture, columns and wide arches based on the remaining ruins scattered throughout the former imperium. Major public works during this period serve as call backs to the time of the imperium including the Cathedral of St. Paul in Rivabella which features a massive dome, still the highest point in Rivabella to this day. 

Fall

The city-state structure of the Panesans would also come to become their downfall. The First North Tuscan Wars starting in 1502 would be brutal as a massive struggle between Monteverdi, Rivabella and Fioralba for territory along the Arno. Control over the fertile land that sustained their growing urban populations had become highly contentious and valued, eventually spilling into open conflict. The weakening of their professional forces known as the Condotteri from this war would allow various foreign powers to step into the void. 

Under the pretext of defending protestants within the turmoil of the Panesan city-states, the Second Hochdeutsche Empire would launch an intervention into Monteveredi. After reaching the city in 1504, the army quickly launched a siege to drive the occupants out. A full naval blockade at sea stalled the enemies resupply as rationing set in. After five months of siege, the Monteverdi Republic collapsed with the Hochdeutsche footsoldiers storming and sacking the city. The Hochdeutsche Emperor would appoint a puppet government for Monteverdi and return to Neudresden victorious. 

The Golden Age of the First Imperial Period set forth by the Erster Kaiser would last from 573 to 760 AD. During the roughly two centuries that encompassed the golden age a strong state and consistent stability would allow the expansion and growth of the Kaiserreich. Internally, the Hochdeutsch Empire went into an era of massive economic and population growth. Massive infrastructure projects including the Kaiserliche Kanal would boost interregional trade. The Kaiserliche Kanal or Imperial Canal in particular would connect the southern breadbasket of the Stahlbasin and the manufacturing cities of the north. Taking seventeen years to complete and thousands of peasant laborers, the Kanal would act as a hydraulic highway that allowed merchants, armies and citizens to transit quickly. Cities along the route including Dunkelberg, Eisenstadt and Stahlbasin would boom into trade centers that would deal in everything from finished products to grain, beer and wool. On top of this a centralized state would allow the revamping of the imperial road system which had long been neglected and destroyed during the centuries of civil war. A grand highway would be built connecting the capital of Stahlbasin and the northern cities. Successive Kaisers would also reform the imperial bureaucracy to include an examination system as well as establishing a public schooling system.
Most importantly, the Kaiser would reform the Kaiserliche Armee. Instead of having city-states running their own militias the Kaisers would centralize the military under an imperial state. On top of this, instead of allowing families to succeed each other in the military, the Kaisers would impose an examination system for recruiting applicants into the Kaiserliche Armee. Another key piece of the Kaiserliche Armee would be its cavalry which would become one of the most effective in northern Eleysr through their emphasis on speed and maneuverability. During this era militarism would become pervasive through society with all members of society being expected to contribute to war efforts.
By 572 a new threat had appeared on the horizon. Muslim caliphates had begun to push from the south into the southern Hochdeutsche reaches. For a weakened Second Empire this would be the make or break moment, to defend its legacy or be annexed into a growing Emirate. When summer had arrived, the feudal armies started to mobilize but the Hochkaiser soon realized that this would not be enough. A seasonal army wouldnt be able to fight the constant onslaught of the professionally trained and equipped forces of the Caliphate. The feudal lords by themselves completely lacked the ability to field constant standing armies but the Hochkaiser could. Using appropriation of assets from the Kriegskult, the Hochkaiser Sachsen was able to raise a standing army to face the Caliphate, just in time for their first incursions. In the summer of 574, the first muslim army was spotted marching on Osterwieck. The Hochkaisers army would march south to meet them. Camping in the town, the men would rest while their attackers moved through the treacherous terrain and summer showers. Osterwiecks geography would benefit them as well. The town was built on an island between two rivers forcing the attacking army to cross them before assailing the defenders. During the crossing the Hochkaisers forces would wait before pushing the attackers back into the waters and drowning them. Around 17,000 Caliphate forces would be killed or wounded during the battle which would come to be known as the Verdict of Osterwiecks.

Finally the Emperor would return this time to subjugate and integrate Rivabella. The shining jewel of the Panesan cultural revival had fallen a long way by 1543 with its major streams of income wrecked and patronage essentially ended. However, its masterpieces still remained, including artwork locked away in cellars to statues buried deep in the castles of the wealthy. As the Hochdeutsche army rolled through northern Panesa the Emperor took care to take the artwork. A great loot of artwork would be carried out with statues, artwork and pieces of reliefs taken back by oxen drawn carts to Neudresden and the imperial palaces of Büdingen and Schwarzstaat. To this day a great share of the art produced during this period of cultural revival is stored in the museums of the Republik. 

Over the centuries these regions would remain the various Empires and Republics that followed and now serve as the 28th province of the Neue Republik of the Hochdeutsche. While the region is largely Panesan it has taken on a national and civic identity as Hochdeutsche with the last referendum on independence acquiring 45.3% for in 2012, thereby keeping the area in the Kaiserreich and later Republik. Currently, the National Panesan Party is pushing for independence and is poised to win a majority in the local parliaments of North and South Panesa.[/spoiler]

[b]Reconstruction | Erene 2000 | Second Flouesch Republic[/b]

[b][sub]Consular Decree concerning Demolitions in the Republic (Consular Decree #14):[/sub][/b]

With the victory of our Republic over the monarchist enemy, one pressing issue remains: the fate of all royalist, aristocratic, and reactionary structures, statues, and historical sites within our New Republic...

It would be a mistake to believe that these structures remaining up wouldn't embolden the enemies of the revolution. We must wipe away the old order to build a new one for the people. Therefore, by order of the First Consul to begin the process of "Deroyalification" Campaign

1) A temporary advisory board will be created to coordinate demolitions of the following structures, the National People's Army, Department of the Interior, and Department of Labor are to coordinate together in the demolition and destruction of these structures

2) All former royal buildings, government offices, and properties are to be demolished and replaced with new buildings. This includes any churches associated with royalist traditions 

3). All statues of former royal figures are to be torn down, destroyed and replaced with statues of revolutionary heroes.

4) Properties belonging to the former aristocracy, or anyone involved in collaboration with royalist forces are to be demolished or reappropriated. Industrial and Economic buildings will be left intact, but seized by the government hence forth.

5) Concerning Velvetel, the Ruins of the Palace of Velvetel, and the coronation grounds are to be demolished and replaced with the "Palace of the Republic," a new building that will house the Revolutionary Council of State, and the Supreme Revolutionary Tribunal upon its completion. Additionally, the old parliament is to be demolished and replaced with the "People's Mansion" to house the executive branch of the Revolutionary Government.  Additionally, the Royal Bank is also likewise ordered to be demolished, and replaced with a reflecting pool to the martyrs of the revolution. The remainder of the city is to be rebuilt in a republican image, this means if a structure appears to be too "royalist" or otherwise connected to former royal institutions, it will be similarly demolished and its space repurposed.

6) Following this, the royal fortress of Nassau-Alzette on the outskirts of velvetel is to be demolished. It will be replaced with Joint Base Velvetel, a base for all branches of the National People's Army, including the Internal Revolutionary Guard to defend the future capital and their respective commands. The Royalist Parade grounds in the city itself will be renamed, but otherwise left intact.

7) Concerning royalist names across towns, cities, and various public institutions. All of the states who have a name of royal origin, whether that be based on the name of a royal family member or royalist, are to be renamed. All signage regarding their original names is to be thus wise, summarily destroyed. 

8) All royalist symbols within cities or on buildings across the republic are to be torn down; additionally, all officially used royalist flags are to be burned.

9) Upon the completion of demolition, the lands of the buildings will be handed over to local authorities to either be sold off or repropriated.

10) Royalist artifacts held within museums are to be removed from displays, and then evaluated on the basis of their historical value to the people of the Republic. If they hold no such value, then they are to be destroyed.

11) The Royal Yacht is to be transferred to Velvetel and docked in its port permanently, it will be spared to destruction due to its historical significance in the Mutiny of 1999, and become a hotel museum combo. The Museum will be named "National Museum on Republicanism" and celebrate the history of the Republican Movement in the country.

Fredrick Muller, First Consul of the Second Flouesch Republic 

With the approval of the Revolutionary Council of State

__________________________________________________________

[b]Act of National Reconstruction[/b]

Reconstruction. "Reconstruction," as the new republican government defined it, was multifaceted. Reconstruction in the terms that the 6-year-long war had caused massive amounts of destruction to the republic's infrastructure, roads had been bombed, intentionally destroyed, or were otherwise littered with disabled or destroyed vehicles. Battleground cities like Wréimséi were in complete ruins after months of continuous pitched urban battles. Power plants were inoperable due to sabotage or intentional destruction. And in general, the national economy was in ruins. And this is not accounting for Vëlvetel, which had been almost completely obliterated during the post-revolution by revolutionary fervor, outside of a few buildings that the National People's Army actually bothered to protect. And  "Reconstruction" in the terms that large portions of the country still resembled its royalist past, and not its new republican future. The royal palace at Vevletel, the Mandigaus Tower in Téiernsbuer, and the Royal Naval Academy at Komend were all now giant hulks that represent thousands of buildings across the republic that These buildings of a kingdom that no longer existed. 

And ""Reconstruction"", this facet was more focused towards the social and demographic aspects. The old social order of the kingdom had been completely crushed, and now in its place was anarchy, additionally an excess of 2.5 million people were now either imprisoned, prohibited from voting, or facing execution for collaboration, or other ties to the former royalist regime. Additionally around 150,000 people had died during the revolution, 50,000 had long lasting injuries, and over 500,000 had been left homeless The Reconstruction Question was now a major political issue in the new republic. How would this government which had barely existed for 6 months even begin to handle such a monumental task? Many in the Radical Republican Party were vengeful.

They wanted nothing more than to see all royalist buildings, including those of industrial use, torn down and replaced. And demanded this be done after they had to concede so much in the initial formation of the Republic's Constitution. Constant protest and demands that the Consul actually make a decision within the halls of the Revolutionary Council of State. Muller had actually avoided this; he wanted to focus on building from the ground up the republic's new government. After all, a constitution would be nothing but a piece of paper if the government were effectively just him calling the shots. But eventually, by the RRP's threats to leave, the government forced his hand. Unwillingly, he issued a revised version of their reconstruction plan through Consular Decree 14 and submitted the "Act on National Reconstruction" to the Staatsrot.  The Consular Decree 14 was effectively an order of the complete obliteration of non industrial, or economic buildings of royalist origins. Along with beginning a program of "De Royalization" of the country, and its history through revising the education systems and names, and through the more literal form of the destruction of royalist historical artifacts. Many in the National Democratic Alliance protested, but the SRF remained silent, begrudgingly accepting this new plan. To appease the vocal opposition of the NDA and the silent one of the NDA.

The "Act on National Reconstruction" would be far milder than Decree 14. The Act was designed to fix the economic aspects of the revolution, while also building the groundwork for fixing larger demographic and social issues within the country. Although these aspects were intentionally left vague to prevent the act from being outright vetoed by the RRP, which called for widescale purges and an outright cultural revolution that would leave the country completely unrecognizable to its pre-war counterpart. The act would be made up of 5 components, starting with section one of the act, stating that the revolutionary government would allocate over 10.5 billion dollars into a "National Reconstruction Authority" or NRA. This temporary government agency, under the direct control of the Department of the Interior, would be supported by the International Revolutionary Guard's Engineer Corps (IRGEC) and would coordinate the reconstruction of the country. Starting with its most immediate goal of rebuilding all roads, wireless communication lines, pipelines, and energy infrastructure across the country. Its second most immediate objective was acting as a conduit to address rising unemployment, with unemployed people being offered work as construction workers, managers, safety inspectors, or electrical engineers, with government-provided job training to those who didn't already have the necessary skills. 

Two, it created a new republic currency. Previously, the Republic had continued using the kingdom's currency; however 6 months in it practically had no international or internal value. Thus, the Flouesch Rouel would be replaced with the Floueschian Marc, which, after tense negotiations with Tailsland, including the exemption of all religious structures belonging to the Lusandric Church, would be pegged to their national currency for the next 10 years. This would grant the fledgling currency stability amid the inevitable economic struggles that the nation would inevitably have to undergo. 

Three, it created the National Urban Reconstruction Authority, or NURA, and allotted 5 billion dollars to it. Its name is a bit misleading; however, it doesn't actually have the authority to rebuild urban areas, which is specifically dedicated to the NRA. Instead, the NURA is specifically tasked with rebuilding the Nation's Capital, Vëlvetel. It was always within revolutionary plans that the government would eventually return to Vëlvetel just as its royal counterpart had. This is for 3 reasons, Téiernsbuer, while being the larger city, did not have the infrastructure to move the entire government there; in fact, only the Revolutionary Council of State was actually there consistently, the executive branch and the revolutionary tribunal were mostly operating out of Komend. Secondly, the Téiernsbuer City Government rejected a proposal made by the RPP to make it the new capital twice, Téiernsbuer didn't want to lose its unique identity as a hot bed of education and the revolution into becoming the national capital, and third. Velvetel had been strategically built on the Moselle River,  a life line for the interior of the country, its central location within the country, and it being practically a blank slate due to all of the destruction both during and after the war made it the most convenient choice as well. The NURA was tasked with building all of the new government buildings and rebuilding the urban infrastructure within the city.

Four, the "Act on National Reconstruction" would create the "Republik Aarbechtsdënscht" (RA), or the Republic Labour Service. While it would accept public recruits mostly on the basis of the NRA's and NURA's recruitment efforts, its primary workforce would be Royalist P.O.Ws. Among the 1.5 million imprisoned in the country, over 200,000 were former royalist soldiers that had largely been the results of the disintegration of the royalist army and the mass surrenders to the revolutionary in the closing days of the war. This section had largely been the brainchild of the Labour Secretariat, Amrei Fischer. A member of the Radical Republican Party, she dictated "...The P.O.Ws currently held within Government Custody have on, each one of them the stain of treason to not only the revolution, but our new republic. They must participate in the efforts to build our republic to remove this stain. They must be given as "reparations" to the government for a lengthy period..." In a speech before the Revolutionary Council of State. Before presenting a full-scale plan that would effectively turn over 100,000 of these men into forced labour to be used in removing minefields, recovering damaged equipment, and assisting in reconstruction all over the country. While the NDA and SRF fiercely opposed the addition of the RA. Muller would manage to save the bill with the fifth, and final provision

Five, the act would finally create a formal system for how the over 1.5 million imprisoned men, women, and children would be released from the overcrowded and overcrowded prison system.  Firstly, the "Staatrost Commission on Clemency for Royalists" would be created with at least 2 members for each party. This board would oversee applications from inmates for clemency, leniency, release, or any sort of official ruling on their case. Additionally, the Komend Trials would be announced, replacing the uncoordinated nature of high-ranking royalists, aristocrats, generals, and collaborators, formally replacing the legal purge. Additionally, Muller issued a general amnesty for all those imprisoned under the age of 18, who were disabled or injured due to the revolution, as permitted by the act. However, children of royalists or aristocrats were excluded, and like the thousands of people now sentenced to be put on trial at kommend, shipped off to the city to face the Supreme Revolutionary Tribunal. Punishments in the Komend Trials could either involve forced participation in the RA, life in prison/time served, to even death. P

And thus, with the negotiations over for the bill. It went to the Staatrots floor for a final vote...

[b]We must Rebuild![/b]
________________________________________________________

[b]Insurgency...[/b]

The Royalist enemy had been beaten, yes, but it had not been extinguished; instead, like cowards, they fled into the darkness, preparing to strike with a dagger. Across the country, thousands of men and women, whether they be royalist army remnants, who were a mix of genuine loyalists, and those afraid of the reprisals that awaited them upon surrender or those pushed to the brink by the Republic's harsh policies aimed at destroying loyalty to the old regime, continued the fight, and continued to fight for the fallen kingdom. They didn't have the support, at least not now, to be a major threat and launch a civil war or counterattack against the republicans. However, they did have one tactic. One of the tactics that the Republicans had also used during their own revolution, and had become so familiar with. [b]Insurgency[/b], asymmetric and guerrilla warfare, bombings, assassinations, acts of sabotage, protests, and strikes among civilian members of the Royalist Insurgency. All would be adopted in the struggle to oust the republicans and restore the Kingdom. For now, the insurgents would mostly attack rail stations and construction equipment. The insurgency's efforts were hampered by a lack of defined leadership. No one was willing to become the public face of the insurgency, or even really lead it. Additionally, the Internal Revolutionary Guard, or IRG, was also designed to fight this exact type of enemy, the leadership and men under the IRG were primarily the guerrilla fighters who had become veterans during the revolution. The IRG would manage to for, at least now keep the Insurgency a low-level threat. Hopefully it stays that way.

It will be replaced with Joint Base Velvetel, a base for all branches of the National People's Army, including the Internal Revolutionary Guard to defend the future capital and their respective commands. The Royalist Parade grounds in the city itself will be renamed, but otherwise left intact.

7) Concerning royalist names across towns, cities, and various public institutions. All of the states who have a name of royal origin, whether that be based on the name of a royal family member or royalist, are to be renamed. All signage regarding their original names is to be thus wise, summarily destroyed. 

8) All royalist symbols within cities or on buildings across the republic are to be torn down; additionally, all officially used royalist flags are to be burned.

9) Upon the completion of demolition, the lands of the buildings will be handed over to local authorities to either be sold off or repropriated.

10) Royalist artifacts held within museums are to be removed from displays, and then evaluated on the basis of their historical value to the people of the Republic. If they hold no such value, then they are to be destroyed.

[b]Act of National Reconstruction[/b]

Reconstruction. "Reconstruction," as the new republican government defined it, was multifaceted. Reconstruction in the terms that the 6-year-long war had caused massive amounts of destruction to the republic's infrastructure, roads had been bombed, intentionally destroyed, or were otherwise littered with disabled or destroyed vehicles. Battleground cities like Wréimséi were in complete ruins after months of continuous pitched urban battles. Power plants were inoperable due to sabotage or intentional destruction. And in general, the national economy was in ruins. And this is not accounting for Vëlvetel, which had been almost completely obliterated during the post-revolution by revolutionary fervor, outside of a few buildings that the National People's Army actually bothered to protect. And  "Reconstruction" in the terms that large portions of the country still resembled its royalist past, and not its new republican future. The royal palace at Vevletel, the Mandigaus Tower in Téiernsbuer, and the Royal Naval Academy at Komend were all now giant hulks that represent thousands of buildings across the republic that These buildings of a kingdom that no longer existed. 

And ""Reconstruction"", this facet was more focused towards the social and demographic aspects. The old social order of the kingdom had been completely crushed, and now in its place was anarchy, additionally an excess of 2.5 million people were now either imprisoned, prohibited from voting, or facing execution for collaboration, or other ties to the former royalist regime. Additionally around 150,000 people had died during the revolution, 50,000 had long lasting injuries, and over 500,000 had been left homeless The Reconstruction Question was now a major political issue in the new republic. How would this government which had barely existed for 6 months even begin to handle such a monumental task? Many in the Radical Republican Party were vengeful.

They wanted nothing more than to see all royalist buildings, including those of industrial use, torn down and replaced. And demanded this be done after they had to concede so much in the initial formation of the Republic's Constitution. Constant protest and demands that the Consul actually make a decision within the halls of the Revolutionary Council of State. Muller had actually avoided this; he wanted to focus on building from the ground up the republic's new government. After all, a constitution would be nothing but a piece of paper if the government were effectively just him calling the shots. But eventually, by the RRP's threats to leave, the government forced his hand. Unwillingly, he issued a revised version of their reconstruction plan through Consular Decree 14 and submitted the "Act on National Reconstruction" to the Staatsrot.  The Consular Decree 14 was effectively an order of the complete obliteration of non industrial, or economic buildings of royalist origins. Along with beginning a program of "De Royalization" of the country, and its history through revising the education systems and names, and through the more literal form of the destruction of royalist historical artifacts. Many in the National Democratic Alliance protested, but the SRF remained silent, begrudgingly accepting this new plan. To appease the vocal opposition of the NDA and the silent one of the NDA.

The "Act on National Reconstruction" would be far milder than Decree 14. The Act was designed to fix the economic aspects of the revolution, while also building the groundwork for fixing larger demographic and social issues within the country. Although these aspects were intentionally left vague to prevent the act from being outright vetoed by the RRP, which called for widescale purges and an outright cultural revolution that would leave the country completely unrecognizable to its pre-war counterpart. The act would be made up of 5 components, starting with section one of the act, stating that the revolutionary government would allocate over 10.5 billion dollars into a "National Reconstruction Authority" or NRA. This temporary government agency, under the direct control of the Department of the Interior, would be supported by the International Revolutionary Guard's Engineer Corps (IRGEC) and would coordinate the reconstruction of the country. Starting with its most immediate goal of rebuilding all roads, wireless communication lines, pipelines, and energy infrastructure across the country. Its second most immediate objective was acting as a conduit to address rising unemployment, with unemployed people being offered work as construction workers, managers, safety inspectors, or electrical engineers, with government-provided job training to those who didn't already have the necessary skills. 

Two, it created a new republic currency. Previously, the Republic had continued using the kingdom's currency; however 6 months in it practically had no international or internal value. Thus, the Flouesch Rouel would be replaced with the Floueschian Marc, which, after tense negotiations with Tailsland, including the exemption of all religious structures belonging to the Lusandric Church, would be pegged to their national currency for the next 10 years. This would grant the fledgling currency stability amid the inevitable economic struggles that the nation would inevitably have to undergo. 

Three, it created the National Urban Reconstruction Authority, or NURA, and allotted 5 billion dollars to it. Its name is a bit misleading; however, it doesn't actually have the authority to rebuild urban areas, which is specifically dedicated to the NRA. Instead, the NURA is specifically tasked with rebuilding the Nation's Capital, Vëlvetel. It was always within revolutionary plans that the government would eventually return to Vëlvetel just as its royal counterpart had. This is for 3 reasons, Téiernsbuer, while being the larger city, did not have the infrastructure to move the entire government there; in fact, only the Revolutionary Council of State was actually there consistently, the executive branch and the revolutionary tribunal were mostly operating out of Komend. Secondly, the Téiernsbuer City Government rejected a proposal made by the RPP to make it the new capital twice, Téiernsbuer didn't want to lose its unique identity as a hot bed of education and the revolution into becoming the national capital, and third. Velvetel had been strategically built on the Moselle River,  a life line for the interior of the country, its central location within the country, and it being practically a blank slate due to all of the destruction both during and after the war made it the most convenient choice as well. The NURA was tasked with building all of the new government buildings and rebuilding the urban infrastructure within the city.

Four, the "Act on National Reconstruction" would create the "Republik Aarbechtsdënscht" (RA), or the Republic Labour Service. While it would accept public recruits mostly on the basis of the NRA's and NURA's recruitment efforts, its primary workforce would be Royalist P.O.Ws. Among the 1.5 million imprisoned in the country, over 200,000 were former royalist soldiers that had largely been the results of the disintegration of the royalist army and the mass surrenders to the revolutionary in the closing days of the war. This section had largely been the brainchild of the Labour Secretariat, Amrei Fischer. A member of the Radical Republican Party, she dictated "...The P.O.Ws currently held within Government Custody have on, each one of them the stain of treason to not only the revolution, but our new republic. They must participate in the efforts to build our republic to remove this stain. They must be given as "reparations" to the government for a lengthy period..." In a speech before the Revolutionary Council of State. Before presenting a full-scale plan that would effectively turn over 100,000 of these men into forced labour to be used in removing minefields, recovering damaged equipment, and assisting in reconstruction all over the country. While the NDA and SRF fiercely opposed the addition of the RA. Muller would manage to save the bill with the fifth, and final provision

Five, the act would finally create a formal system for how the over 1.5 million imprisoned men, women, and children would be released from the overcrowded and overcrowded prison system.  Firstly, the "Staatrost Commission on Clemency for Royalists" would be created with at least 2 members for each party. This board would oversee applications from inmates for clemency, leniency, release, or any sort of official ruling on their case. Additionally, the Komend Trials would be announced, replacing the uncoordinated nature of high-ranking royalists, aristocrats, generals, and collaborators, formally replacing the legal purge. Additionally, Muller issued a general amnesty for all those imprisoned under the age of 18, who were disabled or injured due to the revolution, as permitted by the act. However, children of royalists or aristocrats were excluded, and like the thousands of people now sentenced to be put on trial at kommend, shipped off to the city to face the Supreme Revolutionary Tribunal. Punishments in the Komend Trials could either involve forced participation in the RA, life in prison/time served, to even death. P

[b]Insurgency...[/b]

The Royalist enemy had been beaten, yes, but it had not been extinguished; instead, like cowards, they fled into the darkness, preparing to strike with a dagger. Across the country, thousands of men and women, whether they be royalist army remnants, who were a mix of genuine loyalists, and those afraid of the reprisals that awaited them upon surrender or those pushed to the brink by the Republic's harsh policies aimed at destroying loyalty to the old regime, continued the fight, and continued to fight for the fallen kingdom. They didn't have the support, at least not now, to be a major threat and launch a civil war or counterattack against the republicans. However, they did have one tactic. One of the tactics that the Republicans had also used during their own revolution, and had become so familiar with. [b]Insurgency[/b], asymmetric and guerrilla warfare, bombings, assassinations, acts of sabotage, protests, and strikes among civilian members of the Royalist Insurgency. All would be adopted in the struggle to oust the republicans and restore the Kingdom. For now, the insurgents would mostly attack rail stations and construction equipment. The insurgency's efforts were hampered by a lack of defined leadership. No one was willing to become the public face of the insurgency, or even really lead it. Additionally, the Internal Revolutionary Guard, or IRG, was also designed to fight this exact type of enemy, the leadership and men under the IRG were primarily the guerrilla fighters who had become veterans during the revolution. The IRG would manage to for, at least now keep the Insurgency a low-level threat. Hopefully it stays that way.[/spoiler]
